title: mail3
tagline: Web3 mail system with better feature like video mail.Mail3 is a blockchain-based email service which Allows users to send e-mail through wallet addresses to anybody
description:
Web3 mail system with better feature like video mail.
Not only text should be mails videos too can be mail., with web3 and filecoin it is possible.Mail3 is a blockchain-based email service which Allows users to send e-mail through wallet addresses to anybody,The frontend part was built using React, and Bootstrap. The fronted part was deployed on Spheron. Smart contract was written in Solidity using Remix IDE and Ether.js was used to connect the frontend with the smart contract [Deployed on Filecoin hyperspace]. Web3.storage API was used for storing attached files data on persistent long-term storage provided by Filecoin
